paper_title: Constraints on photon mass and dark photon from the Jovian magnetic field
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter epsilon (dimensionless), exactly as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper sets 95% credible limits on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon vs mass mX using Juno MAG data of Jupiter's magnetic field, via a Bayesian analysis with Jeffreys prior. Limits are independent of the dark photon being dark matter, so no local DM density is assumed. Explicit numerical anchors from text: at eps=1 the exclusion spans 3.2e-18 eV <= mX <= 3.2e-14 eV; strongest bound eps <= 2.8e-3 at mX = 2.0e-15 eV. The full exclusion contour is only shown in Fig. 7, so the emitted 3 points are a sparse skeleton of the contour. Paper also sets a photon mass bound m_gamma < 2.5e-18 eV (not encoded, no matching coupling type).
